traps.scale_nondeterminism: THE regression case for D21. At 1.0x the accession reads X2011.4.10368168; at ~2000px wide it reads X2011.4.10368.168 (correct); at ~4000px it reads X2011.410368.168. Each scale drops a DIFFERENT separator. No confidence, geometry or normalization signal fires on any of them.
traps.date_is_the_exposure: 1947 dates the exposure. The object on the wall is a 'Modern print' made much later and undated. Two production events (D13), and the displayed object is not the 1947 one (D12).
traps.kubrick: Stanley Kubrick as a teenage staff photographer for LOOK, not as a filmmaker. Prime §6.1 triangle-closure material: a learner who knows Kubrick from film encounters him here as a photojournalist.
